manifest_name: Archipelago S5-B1 Embedding Model & Dense Retrieval Manifest

primary_dense_model.architecture: BERT-based dense transformer encoder with mean pooling
primary_dense_model.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
primary_dense_model.normalization: L2 unit sphere normalization (norm = 1.0), enabling dot-product cosine similarity

debugging_baseline.architecture: Murmur/SHA256 token hashing with signed unit projection
debugging_baseline.usage_role: DEBUGGING_ONLY (Fast offline non-semantic baseline for CI pipelines and sanity tests)

hybrid_rrf_configuration.timing_accounting_policy: Full end-to-end latency = T_BM25 + T_Dense + T_Fusion (measuring true retrieval pipeline cost rather than post-hoc rank fusion step alone)

graph_retriever_configuration.fallback_strategy: corpus_bm25 (Deterministic BM25 ranking when no graph anchors match)
graph_retriever_configuration.error_handling: Explicit exception logging without silently swallowed runtime errors

traversal_instrumentation.actual_hop_reporting: Observed traversal depth (0 for fallback, 1 for single-hop, 2 for verified two-hop)
